scope: Working p5.js prompt-to-studio path only; no Processing Java, blind benchmark, portable recipe, or shared target acceptance claim.

capabilities.prompt: A local OpenAI-compatible model uses the server-side typed tool boundary and returns an editable candidate.
capabilities.source: Generated p5.js runs through p5-static-640-v1 in a disposable browser on an isolated origin.
capabilities.composition: The studio composites the content-addressed straight-alpha preview over existing workflow layers.
capabilities.controls: Declared source controls create an edit candidate, rerender from fixed seeds, and apply as one undoable revision.

validation.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build compiled /harness and all harness routes.
validation.runner: python3 tools/harness/check_p5_layer_runner.py passed transparent/opaque alpha, pinned package import, runtime failure, timeout cleanup, network denial, and deterministic replay scenarios.
browser: Generated a transparent navy-circle grid source layer from a natural-language add-layer request using the local Qwen model.
The run completed after 8 tool calls and 1 charged render; candidate cand-0024b2ff-9b26-4a21-87af-24de995e463a applied as layer-2.
The composed canvas showed the navy source raster above the original FieldMarks workflow without a browser error.
Changing density from 0.5 to 0.15 disabled controls while rendering, published a new preview, changed visible circle density, and retained radius 6.
Undo restored density 0.5 and the prior published revision.

limits: The reviewed web experience exposes p5.js only.
Model quality and latency depend on the configured local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Generated source remains an app artifact; it does not change catalog operation or target acceptance.
